title: On some concertinas, each button plays one note when you push and another when you pull
alt: A six-sided concertina with a black body, pierced silver end plate, rows of buttons and a leather hand strap.

posts.facebook:
Here's a surprise for a new player. On an Anglo concertina, each button plays one note when you push the bellows and a different note when you pull.

The concertina is a small bellows instrument you hold between your hands. On the English kind, a button gives the same note either way. The International Concertina Association, a society for players, says the right one for you depends on the music you want to play.

A good concertina costs several hundred pounds or more, so look for a beginners' workshop that lends instruments first, or a players' group near you. The association lists groups in the UK and the US.

Same note both ways, or two notes per button?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-the-concertina/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
